newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.054pts to 100.188.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.054pts to 100.188.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.054 points in Thursday's trading to 100.188, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio rose 0.240 points to 2.579 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.061 points to 96.274, the bank said, while the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.002 points to 2.363 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 4.382 points to 1,164.685.
